about_pullquote: Good preparation and honest work — that's what our customers come back for.
about_para_1: L J M Painters & Decorators has been transforming homes and businesses across Leeds for over 12 years. What started as a small, local operation has grown through personal recommendations and consistent, quality work. We handle everything from quick refresh projects to major redecoration schemes — always with the same attention to detail.
about_para_2: We pride ourselves on turning up on time, communicating clearly, and leaving your home cleaner than we found it. Our customers appreciate that we listen to what you want, give honest advice, and deliver without fuss or hidden costs. That's why so many of our jobs come from repeat customers and local referrals.
